title: Granola footer
description: A white editorial footer: serif column headings over small grey links (one column alone on the left, three on the right on desktop; 2×2 on phones), a row of small social icons and the copyright, and a giant heavy wordmark stretched across the full content width. On desktop it stays pinned under the page, so the content above slides up off it.
notes: reveal (default on): lg:sticky bottom-0 -z-10, so put it last inside an `isolate` page wrapper whose other blocks all have a background
social icons come in as props (e.g. lucide icons)
the wordmark is SVG text stretched to the width
